context: 68yo F w/ hx of HTN and DM2, came in w/ 4 days of cough + fever. CXR showed RLL pneumonia. Started azithromycin 500 mg, felt better by day 2. Kept her home metformin going. Held lisinopril bc BP was low, not restarting.
summary: You were here for pneumonia, which is an infection in your lungs. We gave you azithromycin 500 mg and you got better pretty quick. Keep taking your metformin like normal. Don't take your lisinopril until your doctor says it's ok.

context: 55yo M, L leg red and swollen x3 days, dx cellulitis. Started cephalexin 500 mg QID, redness way down by day 3. Home atorvastatin continued. Stopped his ibuprofen bc kidney numbers were up.
summary: You had cellulitis, a skin infection on your left leg. You're on cephalexin 500 mg four times a day to clear it up. Keep taking atorvastatin. Stop taking ibuprofen for now since it was hard on your kidneys.

context: 72yo F came in w/ palpitations, found in atrial fibrillation w/ HR in the 140s. Rate controlled w/ metoprolol 25 mg BID. Started apixaban for stroke ppx. D/c'd home diltiazem since we started metoprolol. Home levothyroxine continued.
summary: You were here for atrial fibrillation, which means your heart was beating fast and out of rhythm. We started you on metoprolol 25 mg twice a day to slow it down, plus apixaban to lower your stroke risk. We stopped your diltiazem. Keep taking your levothyroxine.

context: 80yo M w/ CHF, admitted for a heart failure exacerbation, leg swelling + SOB, up 6 lbs in a week. Diuresed w/ furosemide 40 mg IV BID, breathing better. Home carvedilol continued. Told him to stop naproxen, it makes him hold fluid.
summary: You came in for a heart failure exacerbation, meaning extra fluid built up in your body. We gave you furosemide 40 mg to pull the fluid off. Keep taking carvedilol. Stop naproxen since it makes you hold onto fluid. Weigh yourself every morning and call if it goes up fast.

context: 84yo F brought in by family for confusion, UA + cx grew E. coli, dx a urinary tract infection. Got ceftriaxone then switched to cephalexin 250 mg to finish 7 days. Home oxybutynin held for confusion and stopped at d/c. Home amlodipine continued.
summary: You were treated for a urinary tract infection, which is also what made you confused. Take cephalexin 250 mg to finish 7 days of antibiotics. Keep taking amlodipine. We stopped your oxybutynin since it can make confusion worse.

context: 63yo M w/ COPD, 2 days of worse SOB + wheezing, admitted for a COPD exacerbation. Prednisone 40 mg daily x5 days + duonebs, back to baseline. Home fluticasone continued. Stopped propranolol, can tighten up the airways.
summary: You were here for a COPD exacerbation, a flare up of your lung disease. You're taking prednisone 40 mg for 5 days total. Keep using your fluticasone inhaler. Don't take propranolol anymore, it can make breathing worse.

context: 50yo F w/ LLQ pain + fever, CT showed diverticulitis. Bowel rest, IV abx, then switched to amoxicillin 875 mg BID. Home sertraline continued. Held her celecoxib bc of the GI stuff, stopping it for good.
summary: You had diverticulitis, which is inflammation in your colon. Finish the amoxicillin 875 mg twice a day. Keep taking your sertraline. Stop taking celecoxib, it can irritate your gut.

context: 41yo M w/ R flank pain + blood in urine, CT showed a kidney stone, 5 mm. Pain controlled, started tamsulosin 0.4 mg daily to help pass it. Home omeprazole continued. Held lisinopril bc of the AKI, stopped at d/c.
summary: You came in with a kidney stone. Take tamsulosin 0.4 mg every day to help it pass. Keep taking omeprazole. We stopped your lisinopril for now since your kidneys were stressed. Strain your urine so we can test the stone.

context: 77yo F, couple days of vomiting + diarrhea, came in w/ dehydration and a high creatinine. Got IV fluids and ondansetron 4 mg for nausea. Home levothyroxine continued. Held furosemide while she was dry, stopped at d/c.
summary: You were in the hospital for dehydration from vomiting and diarrhea. We gave you fluids and ondansetron 4 mg for the nausea. Keep taking levothyroxine. Stop your furosemide until you see your doctor.

context: 46yo M w/ bad upper belly pain, lipase way up, dx pancreatitis. NPO, IV fluids, ondansetron 4 mg for nausea, advanced diet by day 3. Home metformin continued. Stopped his fenofibrate, will recheck lipids outpt.
summary: You had pancreatitis, which is inflammation of your pancreas. We used ondansetron 4 mg for your nausea. Keep taking metformin. Stop taking fenofibrate for now. No alcohol.
